author: claude
summary: Removes RailBookBlock's permanently-expanded chapter-list branch (the rail duplicated ChapterTable.tsx's status orbs, ActionMenu, and progress bars for every chapter under the Contents stage / chapter workspace route). The rail now renders only the book title/cover header and the fixed BOOK_STAGES link row -- chapter browsing/queue/reset/delete stays solely in ChapterTable.tsx (Contents page), which already had full parity. Removed now-dead nav.css selectors backing the deleted markup, and replaced RailBookBlock's tests with negative assertions that the chapter list stays absent across prop changes and simulated route changes within the same book. Confirmed MobileNavDrawer.tsx never rendered RailBookBlock or any chapter-list logic (no change needed there) and that the collapsed rail's hover-to-expand overlay is position:absolute and never changes the rail's own box width, so it cannot reflow the main content pane.

files.change: Deleted the chapter-list branch (getActiveStage/pickChapterJob helpers, showChapters/isChapterWorkspace/activeChapterId computation, and the nested per-chapter StatusOrb/ActionMenu/PredictiveProgressBar markup). Non-compact render is now just the title/cover header button plus a flat BOOK_STAGES.map(...) of NavLinks; compact/collapsed branch is unchanged.

Removed the now-dead .rail-book-block__chapters/__chapter/__chapter-wrap/__chapter-main/__chapter-index/__chapter-title/__chapter-actions/__progress selector block backing the deleted rail chapter markup; updated a stale comment reference to the removed __chapter-wrap--active class.

Replaced positive chapter-row assertions with negative assertions (no chapter titles/rows/progress bars/list container) verified on initial mount at the Contents route and the chapter-workspace route, after a re-render with changed props (chapter count + job set), and after simulated route changes within the same book via MemoryRouter + Routes. Also asserts the stage-link set (Contents/Cast, etc.) renders regardless of chapter/job state.
